title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 10
description:
Elevate your bedroom with a personalized touch with this custom baseball bedding comforter set from Jeminise. Designed for baseball enthusiasts, this set combines style, comfort, and a unique personalized element, making it a thoughtful gift for any occasion.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating determination and passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques to prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting durability.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric with Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling, ensuring a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and fluffs up beautifully.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, ensuring a complete and coordinated look for your bedding.
  • Customization Options: Personalize your bedding with custom name and text inputs, adding a unique touch.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber Filling
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Baseball on US Flag 1
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Special Feature Breathable
Thread Count 400
Closure Type Zipper
Pillowcase Quantity 2
